criteria.description: Leads with Not ready because the bulk implementation lacks server-side member authorisation and allows active projects to be archived.

Discovers from the actual implementation that bulkArchiveProjects never checks actor.role; does not confuse the separate UI visibility helper or legacy single-item check with bulk endpoint enforcement.
Discovers that bulkArchiveProjects checks unpaid invoices but never rejects active projects.
Correctly recognises that confirmation cancellation, unpaid-invoice rejection, data preservation and the unchanged single-project path have supporting code or test evidence.
Uses the real diff, tests, code paths or a focused probe as evidence rather than making unsupported claims.
Does not invent a destructive migration, deletion behaviour or other defect absent from the fixture.
Requires role enforcement and active-project validation in the bulk service plus focused regression tests before shipping.
